THE SAMPLE PERSONAL DATA ACT, 2099
A FICTIONAL TEST FIXTURE. NOT THE TEXT OF ANY LAW.
CHAPTER I
PRELIMINARY
Short title.
1. (1) This Act may be called the Sample Personal Data Act, 2099.
(2) It is a fictional fixture used only to test software.
Definitions.
2. In this Act,—
(a) "Board" means the Sample Data Protection Board;
(b) "personal data" means any data about an identifiable individual.
Application.
3. This Act applies to digital personal data processed by a fiduciary.
Grounds for processing.
4. A fiduciary may process personal data only with consent or for a permitted use.
CHAPTER II
OBLIGATIONS OF FIDUCIARY
Notice.
5. (1) Every request for consent shall be accompanied or preceded by a notice informing the person of—
(i) the personal data and the purpose for which it is proposed to be processed;
(ii) the manner in which the person may exercise rights, including withdrawal of consent and grievance redressal; and
(iii) the manner in which the person may make a complaint to the Board.
(2) Where consent was given before this Act, the fiduciary shall give such notice as soon as practicable.
(3) The person shall have the option to read the notice in English or in any language listed in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution.
Consent.
6. (1) Consent shall be free, specific, informed, unconditional and unambiguous, with a clear affirmative action.
(2) The person may withdraw consent at any time, with ease comparable to giving it.
Certain permitted uses.
7. A fiduciary may process personal data without consent for a use permitted by this section.
General obligations.
8. (1) A fiduciary shall protect personal data by taking reasonable security safeguards to prevent a personal data breach.
(2) In the event of a personal data breach, the fiduciary shall give intimation of the breach to the Board and to each affected person.
(3) The fiduciary shall erase personal data when consent is withdrawn or the purpose is no longer served.
